An anchor wrapping a block that holds another anchor records its destination once, not twice

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"/o\"><div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
